s.note: Crisp buttered filo triangles filled with feta, ricotta, egg and fresh mint
s.how: Heat the oven to 190C. Mix 200g crumbled feta, 100g ricotta, 1 egg, 1 tbsp chopped mint and plenty of black pepper. Brush a sheet of filo with melted butter, lay another on top, brush again and cut lengthways into 3 strips. Repeat with the rest of 8 sheets and 100g butter. Put a heaped teaspoon of filling at the end of each strip and fold over and over into a triangle, then brush the tops. Bake on lined trays for 20 minutes until crisp and golden and cool for 5 minutes before serving.

s.note: Little fried Greek meatballs of beef, mint and oregano, with cool garlic and cucumber tzatziki and lemon
s.how: Mix 250g Greek yoghurt with 1 grated and squeezed Lebanese cucumber, 1 grated garlic clove, 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tbsp chopped dill and chill. Mix 500g beef mince, 1 grated small onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 50g fresh breadcrumbs soaked in 3 tbsp milk, 1 egg, 2 tbsp chopped mint, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt and pepper. Roll into walnut-sized balls and roll in 50g plain flour. Fry in batches in 125ml olive oil over medium high heat for about 6 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through. Drain and serve hot with the tzatziki and lemon wedges.

m.n: Gus's front-yard lamb with lemon potatoes
m.note: Butterflied lamb leg in lemon, garlic and oregano, charred on the barbecue, with roasted Greek lemon potatoes
m.how: Mix 80ml olive oil, the juice of 2 lemons, 4 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp dried oregano and 1 tsp salt, rub all over a 1.8kg butterflied lamb leg and marinate in the fridge for 2 hours. Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 1.2kg potato wedges in a roasting tin with 60ml olive oil, the juice of 2 lemons, 2 sliced garlic cloves and 1 tsp oregano, pour in 250ml chicken stock and roast for 1 hour, turning twice, until golden and the liquid has gone. Meanwhile heat a barbecue to high and cook the lamb for 10 to 12 minutes a side until charred outside and pink inside, then rest under foil for 15 minutes. Carve thickly and serve with the potatoes and pan juices.

w.note: Walnut, orange and cinnamon butter cake baked in a ring tin and soaked in honey orange syrup
w.how: Heat the oven to 170C and butter and flour a 24cm Bundt tin. Beat 200g soft butter with 200g caster sugar until pale, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time with the zest of 1 orange. Fold in 250g self-raising flour, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 150g chopped walnuts and 125g Greek yoghurt, spoon into the tin and bake for 45 minutes. Meanwhile simmer 200g caster sugar, 200ml water, 3 tbsp honey, the juice of 2 oranges and a cinnamon stick for 5 minutes, then cool. Cool the cake in the tin for 10 minutes, turn out and spoon the cool syrup slowly over the hot cake. Leave to soak for 30 minutes before slicing.

d.note: Instant coffee and sugar shaken to a thick foam, poured over ice and topped with cold milk
d.how: Shake 4 tsp instant coffee, 4 tsp caster sugar and 120ml cold water hard in a sealed jar for 1 minute until thick and pale. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, spoon in the coffee foam and slowly top each with 100ml cold milk. Serve with a straw.
